Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Greetings, this is the announcement of the 2011 French European Championship Qualifier (ECQ).
*** 2011 French ECQ ***

Date: Saturday, May 28, 2011
Registration: 14:15
First round starting time: 14:30
Expected finishing time: 23:15

Format: Standard Constructed, detailed rules can be found on the VEKN Tournament Rules webpage.
www.vekn.net/index.php/tournament-rules

Number of rounds: 3 + final
Time limit per round: 2 hours

This year we will participate for the fifth time to the game convention  Ludicité that will take place Saturday 28th may 2011 in Paris, 75011, at La Petite Rockette, 6 rue Saint-Maur.
(subway station Voltaire (line 9), Philippe Auguste (line 2) or Père-Lachaise (line 2 or 3))

In parallel to our initiation games will take place the European Championship Qualifier.

I remind here that the Ludicité is free and that they sell food and drinks at the price of your choice.

The tournament itself has a registration fee of 5€.

14h-14h20 : registration WE WILL NOT WAIT FOR LATECOMERS (the organizer will decide if you may join in round 2)
14:30-16:30 : round 1
16:45-18:45 : round 2
19:00-21:00 : round 3
21:15-23:15 : final round

The Ludicité continues until 6 A.M., you may stay after the tournament if you want to play some extra games. However, the doors will close around midnight. Afterwards, you may not come back in if you leave.

Pre-registration there : www.veknfrance.com/forum/viewtopic.php?p=187086

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
